attributes.comment: Averaged over the period since the most recent 00, 06, 12 or 18 UTC strictly before this time, so the period is 1 hour at 01, 07, 13 and 19 UTC and lengthens to 6 hours at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC. NaN where the source reports no low cloud in the column. Every cell where average_low_cloud_cover is zero is NaN, as are some cells at the edge of a cloud field where it is small.
